topic: What is addiction and how does it work?
scientific_reframing: How do reward learning, incentive salience, stress and withdrawal, executive control, memory-driven cues, and genetic/environmental risk interact over time to produce compulsive substance or behavior seeking, and which mechanisms can be measured and safely modified without reducing addiction to a moral failure or a single neurotransmitter?
human_review_items: Review addiction medicine, withdrawal, overdose, psychiatric, and crisis safety before any physical study.
Review consent, privacy, genetic governance, fairness, stigmatization, and patient autonomy.
Review the distinction between cue-memory behavior, subjective craving, neural representation, and artificial-memory animal findings.
Review relapse definitions, power, treatment access, clinic and ancestry calibration, and non-target reward outcomes.
